data.source_text: 海关清关流程包括申报、查验、征税和放行四个主要环节。
data.target_text: The customs clearance process includes four main stages: declaration, inspection, taxation, and release.

data.source_text: 出口货物需要提供原产地证书才能享受关税优惠。
data.target_text: Export goods need to provide Certificate of Origin to enjoy tariff preferences.

data.source_text: 使用信用证支付可以降低出口商的收汇风险。
data.target_text: Using Letter of Credit payment can reduce exchange collection risk for exporters.

data.source_text: 买方应在收到货物后7个工作日内进行验收，如有质量问题应在15个工作日内提出异议。
data.target_text: The buyer should conduct acceptance within 7 working days after receiving the goods, and raise objections within 15 working days if there are quality issues.

data.source_text: 该产品符合国际质量标准，通过ISO9001质量管理体系认证。
data.target_text: This product meets international quality standards and is certified under the ISO9001 quality management system.

data.source_text: 根据FOB条款，卖方负责将货物运至装运港并装上买方指定的船只。
data.target_text: Under FOB terms, the seller is responsible for transporting the goods to the port of shipment and loading them onto the vessel designated by the buyer.

data.source_text: 提单是承运人收到货物后签发给托运人的凭证，也是物权凭证。
data.target_text: The Bill of Lading is a receipt issued by the carrier to the shipper for the goods received, and it also serves as a document of title.

data.source_text: 由于不可抗力导致合同无法履行，受影响方应及时通知另一方。
data.target_text: If the contract cannot be performed due to force majeure, the affected party shall notify the other party in a timely manner.

data.source_text: 查询该商品的HS编码可以确定其在进口国的适用关税税率。
data.target_text: Checking the HS code of the product can determine its applicable tariff rate in the importing country.

data.source_text: 货运代理协议中应明确双方在货物运输过程中的权利与义务。
data.target_text: The freight forwarding agreement should clarify the rights and obligations of both parties during the transportation of goods.

data.source_text: 电汇（T/T）是一种常见的国际贸易结算方式，具有速度快、手续简便的特点。
data.target_text: Telegraphic Transfer (T/T) is a common international trade settlement method characterized by its speed and simple procedures.

data.source_text: 形式发票通常用于买方向银行申请进口许可证或开立信用证。
data.target_text: A proforma invoice is typically used by the buyer to apply for an import license or open a letter of credit with a bank.

data.source_text: 保税仓库允许进口货物在未缴纳关税的情况下暂时储存。
data.target_text: A bonded warehouse allows imported goods to be temporarily stored without paying customs duties.

data.source_text: 装箱单必须详细列明每件包装内的货物名称、规格及数量。
data.target_text: The packing list must detail the name, specification, and quantity of the goods inside each package.

data.source_text: 如果买方未能按期付款，卖方有权按日计收逾期违约金。
data.target_text: If the buyer fails to make payment on time, the seller has the right to charge daily liquidated damages for late payment.

data.source_text: 所有出口至该地区的电子产品必须符合CE安全认证标准。
data.target_text: All electronic products exported to this region must comply with CE safety certification standards.

data.source_text: 保险费由卖方支付，保险金额应按CIF发票金额的110%投保。
data.target_text: The insurance premium shall be paid by the seller, and the insured amount should be 110% of the CIF invoice value.

data.source_text: 国际贸易中的仲裁协议是解决合同争议的高效方式。
data.target_text: The arbitration agreement in international trade is an efficient way to resolve contract disputes.

data.source_text: 拼箱货（LCL）是指托运人的货物量不足一个整箱，需与其他托运人的货物合拼。
data.target_text: Less than Container Load (LCL) refers to a shipment where the shipper's cargo is insufficient for a full container and needs to be consolidated with others.

data.source_text: 该商品的出口退税率已由9%上调至13%。
data.target_text: The export tax rebate rate for this product has been increased from 9% to 13%.

data.source_text: 代理商应每季度向委托人提交一份市场销售报告。
data.target_text: The agent shall submit a market sales report to the principal every quarter.

data.source_text: 如有任何规格变动，卖方必须在发货前至少15天书面通知买方。
data.target_text: If there are any changes in specifications, the seller must notify the buyer in writing at least 15 days before shipment.

data.source_text: 目的地交货（DAP）条款下，卖方承担将货物运至指定目的地的一切风险和费用。
data.target_text: Under Delivered at Place (DAP) terms, the seller bears all risks and costs to transport the goods to the named destination.

data.source_text: 进口许可证的有效期通常为六个月，过期需重新申请。
data.target_text: The validity of an import license is usually six months; it must be reapplied for after expiration.

data.source_text: 货物的毛重和净重应在所有货运单据上保持一致。
data.target_text: The gross weight and net weight of the goods should remain consistent on all shipping documents.

data.source_text: 知识产权侵权可能导致货物被海关扣押并处以罚款。
data.target_text: Intellectual property rights infringement may lead to the seizure of goods by customs and the imposition of fines.

data.source_text: 分期付款协议有助于缓解买方的资金流动压力。
data.target_text: An installment payment agreement helps to ease the cash flow pressure on the buyer.

data.source_text: 本合同受中华人民共和国法律管辖并按其解释。
data.target_text: This contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the People's Republic of China.

data.source_text: 冷链物流在易腐食品出口中起着至关重要的作用。
data.target_text: Cold chain logistics plays a vital role in the export of perishable food items.

data.source_text: 商业发票应包含合同号、装运标记以及详细的单价与总价。
data.target_text: The commercial invoice should contain the contract number, shipping marks, and detailed unit prices and total prices.

data.source_text: 商检证书是证明出口商品质量、规格及重量的重要依据。
data.target_text: The commodity inspection certificate is an important basis for proving the quality, specifications, and weight of exported goods.

data.source_text: 在EXW条款下，卖方仅负责在工厂所在地将货物交给买方。
data.target_text: Under EXW terms, the seller is only responsible for making the goods available to the buyer at the factory premises.

data.source_text: 预计抵达时间（ETA）可能会受天气或港口拥堵影响而延迟。
data.target_text: The Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) may be delayed due to weather conditions or port congestion.

data.source_text: 银行手续费通常由买卖双方根据合同约定各自承担。
data.target_text: Bank charges are usually borne by the buyer and seller respectively, as agreed upon in the contract.

data.source_text: 买方应在货物到达后的48小时内通过书面形式通知卖方任何短装情况。
data.target_text: The buyer shall notify the seller in writing of any short shipment within 48 hours after the arrival of the goods.

data.source_text: 所有化学品出口都必须附带最新的化学品安全说明书（MSDS）。
data.target_text: All chemical exports must be accompanied by the latest Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS).

data.source_text: 运费预付（Freight Prepaid）表示运费已在起运港支付完毕。
data.target_text: Freight Prepaid indicates that the freight charges have been fully paid at the port of origin.

data.source_text: 付款交单（D/P）是一种商业信用结算方式，银行仅在收到货款后交付单据。
data.target_text: Documents against Payment (D/P) is a commercial credit settlement method where the bank only releases documents upon receipt of payment.

data.source_text: 如果产品在保修期内出现非人为故障，卖方将负责免费维修或更换。
data.target_text: If the product malfunctions during the warranty period due to non-human factors, the seller will be responsible for free repair or replacement.

data.source_text: 反倾销税是针对以低于成本价倾销的进口商品征收的惩罚性关税。
data.target_text: Anti-dumping duty is a punitive tariff levied on imported goods dumped at prices below cost.

data.source_text: 装运标记（Shipping Marks）必须清晰地刷在包装箱的两个侧面上。
data.target_text: Shipping marks must be clearly stenciled on two sides of the packing cases.

data.source_text: 买方同意对在交易过程中获取的所有商业机密保密。
data.target_text: The buyer agrees to keep all commercial secrets obtained during the transaction confidential.

data.source_text: 信用证项下的所有单据必须在有效期内提交给开证行。
data.target_text: All documents under the Letter of Credit must be submitted to the issuing bank within the validity period.

data.source_text: 承运人对由于包装不当导致的货物损毁不承担赔偿责任。
data.target_text: The carrier shall not be liable for any damage to the goods caused by improper packaging.

data.source_text: 由于市场价格波动，卖方保留随时调整产品价格的权利。
data.target_text: The seller reserves the right to adjust product prices at any time due to market price fluctuations.

data.source_text: 本合同一式两份，双方各执一份，具有同等法律效力。
data.target_text: This contract is made in duplicate, with each party holding one copy, both being equally authentic.

data.source_text: 该批货物将从上海港出发，在新加坡港进行中转。
data.target_text: The batch of goods will depart from Shanghai Port and be transshipped at Singapore Port.

data.source_text: 关税起征点根据各国海关政策的不同而有所差异。
data.target_text: The de minimis threshold for customs duties varies according to different countries' customs policies.

data.source_text: 双方应本着友好协商的原则解决合同执行中出现的争议。
data.target_text: Both parties shall resolve any disputes arising from the execution of the contract based on the principle of friendly consultation.

data.source_text: 增值税（VAT）发票是买方在当地申请抵扣进项税的重要凭证。
data.target_text: A Value-Added Tax (VAT) invoice is an important voucher for the buyer to apply for input tax deduction locally.

data.source_text: 所有出口木质包装必须经过熏蒸处理并加盖IPPC标识。
data.target_text: All exported wooden packaging must undergo fumigation treatment and be stamped with the IPPC mark.

data.source_text: 卖方应向买方提供最终用户的最终用途证明。
data.target_text: The seller shall provide the buyer with an end-user and end-use certificate.

data.source_text: 由于买方未及时开立信用证，交货日期将相应顺延。
data.target_text: As the buyer failed to open the Letter of Credit on time, the delivery date will be postponed accordingly.

data.source_text: 运费到付（Freight Collect）意味着运费将由收货人在目的港支付。
data.target_text: Freight Collect means that the freight charges will be paid by the consignee at the destination port.

data.source_text: 产品规格书应包含详细的物理特性、化学成分和技术指标。
data.target_text: The product specification sheet should contain detailed physical properties, chemical composition, and technical indicators.

data.source_text: 海关编码的准确性直接影响到出口退税申报的成功率。
data.target_text: The accuracy of the HS code directly affects the success rate of the export tax rebate application.

data.source_text: 样品费和快递费通常由买方预付，大货订单确认后可冲抵货款。
data.target_text: Sample fees and express charges are usually prepaid by the buyer and can be offset against the payment after the bulk order is confirmed.

data.source_text: 未经另一方书面同意，任何一方不得将本合同项下的权利转让给第三方。
data.target_text: Neither party may assign its rights under this contract to a third party without the prior written consent of the other party.

data.source_text: 托盘化装运可以有效提高货物的装卸效率并减少破损率。
data.target_text: Palletized shipment can effectively improve the efficiency of loading and unloading and reduce the damage rate.

data.source_text: 双方确认，在本合同签署前所有口头协议均已失效。
data.target_text: Both parties confirm that all oral agreements prior to the signing of this contract are no longer valid.

data.source_text: 在CIF条款下，卖方必须支付将货物运至指定目的港所需的运费和保险费。
data.target_text: Under CIF terms, the seller must pay the costs, freight, and insurance necessary to bring the goods to the named port of destination.

data.source_text: 空运单（AWB）是不可转让的单据，仅作为货物收据和运输契约。
data.target_text: An Air Waybill (AWB) is a non-negotiable document that serves only as a cargo receipt and a contract of carriage.

data.source_text: 凭单付款（CAD）是一种支付方式，买方需在银行交单时支付全额货款。
data.target_text: Cash Against Documents (CAD) is a payment method where the buyer pays the full amount upon presentation of documents by the bank.

data.source_text: 出入境检验检疫局签发的品质证书是信用证项下必备的议付单据之一。
data.target_text: The Certificate of Quality issued by the CIQ is one of the essential negotiation documents under the Letter of Credit.

data.source_text: 卖方逾期交货应向买方支付违约金，金额为合同总价的5%。
data.target_text: In the event of delayed delivery, the seller shall pay the buyer liquidated damages amounting to 5% of the total contract value.

data.source_text: 利用自由贸易协定（FTA）项下的优惠原产地证可以大幅降低进口关税。
data.target_text: Utilizing a Preferential Certificate of Origin under a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) can significantly reduce import duties.

data.source_text: 集装箱封条号码必须与提单及装箱单上的记录完全一致。
data.target_text: The container seal number must strictly match the records on the Bill of Lading and the packing list.

data.source_text: 双方同意采用AQL 2.5作为本批次货物的验收抽样标准。
data.target_text: Both parties agree to adopt AQL 2.5 as the acceptance sampling standard for this batch of goods.

data.source_text: 赊销（O/A）条款下，卖方先发货，买方在约定时间内付款，这对卖方风险较高。
data.target_text: Under Open Account (O/A) terms, the seller ships the goods first and the buyer pays within an agreed timeframe, which poses a higher risk to the seller.

data.source_text: 出口退税是指对出口货物在国内生产和流通环节缴纳的增值税进行退付。
data.target_text: Export tax rebate refers to the refund of Value-Added Tax paid during the domestic production and distribution of exported goods.

data.source_text: 该产品的最小起订量（MOQ）为1000件，低于此数量将不予发货。
data.target_text: The Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for this product is 1,000 units; orders below this quantity will not be shipped.

data.source_text: 若协商不成，任何一方均可将争议提交给被告所在地法院提起诉讼。
data.target_text: If no settlement can be reached through negotiation, either party may submit the dispute to the court in the place where the defendant is located for litigation.

data.source_text: 滞港费和滞箱费通常由于清关延迟或收货人未能及时提货而产生。
data.target_text: Demurrage and detention charges are usually incurred due to customs clearance delays or the consignee's failure to pick up the goods on time.

data.source_text: 产品包装上必须醒目标注生产日期和保质期。
data.target_text: The production date and shelf life must be prominently marked on the product packaging.

data.source_text: 国际贸易“单一窗口”系统实现了海关、税务、外汇等部门的数据共享。
data.target_text: The International Trade 'Single Window' system enables data sharing among customs, tax, and foreign exchange departments.

data.source_text: 禁止和限制进口商品目录会根据国家安全和环境保护需要进行调整。
data.target_text: The catalogue of prohibited and restricted import commodities will be adjusted according to national security and environmental protection needs.

data.source_text: 内陆运费（Inevitable Inland Haulage）涵盖了从工厂到出口装运港的陆路运输成本。
data.target_text: Inland haulage covers the road transport costs from the factory to the export shipping port.

data.source_text: 请确保受益人名称与银行账户开户名完全一致，以免退汇。
data.target_text: Please ensure that the beneficiary name is exactly the same as the bank account holder's name to avoid payment rejection.

data.source_text: 一方严重违约时，另一方有权立即解除合同并要求赔偿损失。
data.target_text: In the event of a material breach of contract by one party, the other party has the right to terminate the contract immediately and claim damages.

data.source_text: 工厂需在发货前提供详细的成品检验报告（FQC）。
data.target_text: The factory must provide a detailed Final Quality Control (FQC) report before shipment.

data.source_text: 领事发票是由进口国驻出口国的领事馆签发的，用作报关的证明文件。
data.target_text: A Consular Invoice is issued by the consulate of the importing country in the exporting country, used as a certifying document for customs entry.

data.source_text: 滚装船运输特别适用于汽车及重型机械等无需吊装的货物。
data.target_text: Ro-Ro (Roll-on/roll-off) shipping is particularly suitable for goods like vehicles and heavy machinery that do not require hoisting.

data.source_text: 视同出口是指在国内销售但享受出口退税政策的特殊贸易行为。
data.target_text: Deemed export refers to special trade activities where goods are sold domestically but enjoy export tax rebate policies.

data.source_text: 本合同包含非竞争条款，乙方在合同结束后一年内不得从事同类业务。
data.target_text: This contract includes a non-compete clause; Party B shall not engage in similar businesses for one year after the termination of the contract.

data.source_text: 第三方支付托管服务为跨境电商交易提供了资金安全保障。
data.target_text: Third-party escrow payment services provide financial security for cross-border e-commerce transactions.

data.source_text: 意向书（LOI）仅表达合作意愿，通常不具有法律约束力。
data.target_text: A Letter of Intent (LOI) only expresses the willingness to cooperate and is usually not legally binding.

data.source_text: 危险品申报不实可能导致严重的法律后果及高额罚款。
data.target_text: Misdeclaration of dangerous goods may lead to severe legal consequences and heavy fines.

data.source_text: 暂时进境货物应在规定期限内复运出境，否则需补缴关税。
data.target_text: Temporarily imported goods should be re-exported within the specified period; otherwise, customs duties must be paid.

data.source_text: 跨境B2B交易平台通过数字化手段简化了传统外贸的繁琐流程。
data.target_text: Cross-border B2B trading platforms simplify the tedious processes of traditional foreign trade through digital means.

data.source_text: 如果本合同的任何条款被判定为无效，不影响其他条款的效力。
data.target_text: If any provision of this contract is held to be invalid, it shall not affect the validity of the remaining provisions.

data.source_text: 在货运承运人（FCA）条款下，卖方负责在指定地点将货物交给买方指定的承运人。
data.target_text: Under Free Carrier (FCA) terms, the seller is responsible for delivering the goods to the carrier nominated by the buyer at the named place.

data.source_text: 海外仓模式可以显著提升跨境电商的物流配送速度和退换货便利性。
data.target_text: The overseas warehouse model can significantly improve the logistics delivery speed and the convenience of returns and exchanges for cross-border e-commerce.

data.source_text: SWIFT代码是银行间进行国际转账时用于识别特定银行的唯一标识符。
data.target_text: The SWIFT code is a unique identifier used to identify a specific bank during international interbank transfers.

data.source_text: 所有进入欧盟市场的电子产品都必须符合RoHS环保指令的要求。
data.target_text: All electronic products entering the EU market must comply with the requirements of the RoHS environmental directive.

data.source_text: 本合同的任何修改或补充均须经双方签字盖章后方可生效。
data.target_text: Any modification or supplement to this contract shall only become effective after being signed and sealed by both parties.

data.source_text: 备用信用证（Standby L/C）主要作为担保工具，在申请人违约时由银行履行支付义务。
data.target_text: A Standby Letter of Credit (Standby L/C) mainly serves as a guarantee tool, where the bank fulfills the payment obligation if the applicant defaults.

data.source_text: 如果货物在运输途中发生全损，投保人可根据保险单据向保险公司索赔。
data.target_text: If the goods suffer a total loss during transit, the policyholder may claim compensation from the insurance company based on the insurance documents.

data.source_text: 出口商应确保所提供的发票金额与报关单金额完全一致，以规避合规风险。
data.target_text: Exporters should ensure that the invoice amount is exactly the same as the customs declaration amount to avoid compliance risks.

data.source_text: 独家代理协议规定，委托人在特定区域内不得委派其他代理人。
data.target_text: The exclusive agency agreement stipulates that the principal shall not appoint other agents within a specific territory.

data.source_text: 赔偿条款应涵盖由于产品缺陷给买方造成的直接和间接经济损失。
data.target_text: The indemnification clause should cover both direct and indirect economic losses caused to the buyer by product defects.

data.source_text: 转船提单是指货物在运输过程中需要转换另一艘船舶继续运输时签发的提单。
data.target_text: A transshipment bill of lading is a bill of lading issued when goods need to be transferred to another vessel during transit to continue transportation.

data.source_text: 原产地规则是各国为了确定商品“国籍”而制定的一系列法律和行政规定。
data.target_text: Rules of origin are a set of laws and administrative regulations established by countries to determine the 'nationality' of goods.

data.source_text: 买方应在收到单据后的五个银行工作日内完成信用证项下的审单工作。
data.target_text: The buyer shall complete the examination of documents under the Letter of Credit within five banking working days after receiving the documents.

data.source_text: 根据CIP条款，卖方必须投保最高险种（通常为伦敦保险协会货物保险A条款）。
data.target_text: According to CIP terms, the seller must obtain insurance cover complying with the maximum cover (typically Institute Cargo Clauses A).

data.source_text: 工厂接受OEM订单，可根据客户提供的设计图纸进行贴牌生产。
data.target_text: The factory accepts OEM orders and can carry out private label production based on the design drawings provided by the customer.

data.source_text: 如果发生罢工、动乱或战争等情况，运输合同中的免责条款将生效。
data.target_text: In the event of strikes, riots, or war, the force majeure clauses in the transport contract will take effect.

data.source_text: 越南海关近期启用的自动货物放行系统（VASSCM），显著减少了港口提货的人工干预。
data.target_text: The Vietnam Automated System for Seaport Customs Management (VASSCM), recently enabled by Vietnam Customs, has significantly reduced manual intervention in port pickup.

data.source_text: 在菲律宾设立区域总部（RHQ），可以享受免除关税以及外籍雇员个人所得税的优惠。
data.target_text: Establishing a Regional Headquarters (RHQ) in the Philippines allows for exemptions from customs duties and incentives on personal income tax for foreign employees.

data.source_text: RCEP区域内的服务贸易负面清单模式，为金融、电信等领域的跨境服务提供了更高透明度。
data.target_text: The negative list model for trade in services within the RCEP region provides higher transparency for cross-border services in sectors such as finance and telecommunications.

data.source_text: 由于东南亚部分地区电力供应不稳定，建设海外仓时需考虑备用发电机组及UPS系统。
data.target_text: Due to unstable power supplies in parts of Southeast Asia, backup generator sets and UPS systems should be considered when building overseas warehouses.

data.source_text: 出口至新加坡的含糖饮料必须标注分级标签（Nutri-Grade），并遵守关于高糖含量的禁广规定。
data.target_text: Sugar-sweetened beverages exported to Singapore must be labeled with a Nutri-Grade and comply with advertising bans on high sugar content.

data.source_text: 印度尼西亚的单一价格政策旨在解决偏远地区燃油和基本生活用品价格过高的问题。
data.target_text: Indonesia's One Price Policy aims to address the issue of excessively high prices for fuel and basic necessities in remote areas.

data.source_text: 中泰互免签证协定的生效，极大地便利了两国商务人员的往来和展会考察。
data.target_text: The entry into force of the China-Thailand mutual visa exemption agreement has greatly facilitated the travel of business personnel and exhibition inspections between the two countries.

data.source_text: 在印尼进行股权转让，需经过法律和人权部的审批并在当地报纸进行公示。
data.target_text: Transferring equity in Indonesia requires approval from the Ministry of Law and Human Rights and public notice in local newspapers.

data.source_text: 越南北部的海防和广宁省，正逐渐成为承接中国电子供应链转移的首选之地。
data.target_text: Hai Phong and Quang Ninh provinces in northern Vietnam are gradually becoming the preferred locations for receiving shifts in China's electronics supply chain.

data.source_text: 马来西亚的电子原产地证（e-CO）已支持通过区块链平台进行实时验证，防止单证伪造。
data.target_text: Malaysia's electronic Certificate of Origin (e-CO) now supports real-time verification through blockchain platforms to prevent document forgery.

data.source_text: 出口商应关注印尼关于“强制性标签”的语言要求，通常必须包含印尼语翻译。
data.target_text: Exporters should pay attention to Indonesia's language requirements for 'Mandatory Labeling,' which usually must include Indonesian translations.

data.source_text: 中越跨境经济合作区内的“两国一检”模式，旨在实现货物的只查验一次即放行。
data.target_text: The 'Two Countries, One Inspection' model within the China-Vietnam Cross-border Economic Cooperation Zone aims to achieve cargo release after only one inspection.

data.source_text: 在国际工程承包中，使用新加坡法作为准据法可以为跨国合作提供可预测的法律环境。
data.target_text: In international engineering contracting, using Singapore law as the governing law can provide a predictable legal environment for transnational cooperation.

data.source_text: 随着RCEP的深入实施，中国与东盟国家之间的产业链韧性将得到进一步增强。
data.target_text: With the in-depth implementation of RCEP, the supply chain resilience between China and ASEAN countries will be further enhanced.
